claims.statement: AgeClockShift-up: on GSE142439 paired normal/treated EPIC arrays, the Horvath353 DNAm age signature decreases in treated samples relative to paired normal within each donor; this is a local age_signature-layer NameCert and does not entail cell identity, function, safety, rejuvenation, partial reprogramming, renewable maintenance, or immortality potential.

AgeClockShift-up robustness: on the frozen GSE142439 paired normal/treated EPIC arrays scored by Horvath353, support is limited to age_signature-layer directional robustness when both cell-type strata have negative mean paired DNAm age deltas and every leave-one-donor-out overall mean delta remains negative; this does not entail cell identity, function, safety, rejuvenation, partial reprogramming, renewable maintenance, or immortality potential.

GSE165177 MPTR processed RNA-seq provides a cell_identity-layer sameSig_I test over donor-matched exp2 day-10 negative-control and transiently reprogrammed fibroblast samples; under the fixed marker thresholds the identity distance check is within bound but pluripotency exclusion breaks, so this packet is negative evidence for this sameSig_I join and does not promote IdentityPreservingAgeResetUp.

Same-scope MPTR IdentityPreservingAgeReset-up test: join GSE165179 EPIC methylation DNAm age and GSE165177 RNA identity markers by donor plus day-10 exp2 transiently reprogrammed scope; support requires DNAm age decrease and sameSig_I with pluripotency exclusion in the joined scope, while a pluripotency break blocks the joint carrier even when age decreases.

Decomposes the day-10 sameSig_I pluripotency break to donor/marker level on GSE165177 MPTR donor-matched negative-control versus transiently reprogrammed fibroblast RNA-seq samples; this is a structured negative-evidence certificate and does not promote identity preservation, rejuvenation, renewable maintenance, safety, or immortality claims.

MPTR promotion-frontier scan: across the full GSE165179 methylation and GSE165177 RNA time series, exact donor/day/condition/experiment joins classify each scope by DNAm age gain, fibroblast identity-marker RMS, and pluripotency-marker safety deltas. Under the fixed thresholds no Case 3 scope is found, so this is negative evidence for identity-safe age-reset promotion in this contact while downstream rejuvenation, maintenance, and immortality claims remain blocked.

Coverage-bound AgeClockShift-up: on GSE142439 paired normal/treated EPIC arrays, the Horvath353 coefficient table has 334 covered CpGs and 19 missing CpGs; the missing-coordinate absolute coefficient bound makes the admissible age_signature-layer name CoveredHorvath334AgeClockShift↑ rather than Horvath353AgeClockShift↑. This does not entail identity, function, safety, rejuvenation, maintenance, or immortality claims.

FunctionSignatureShift-up mouse marker-direction probe: GSE190986 RNA-seq SubSeries linked to the GSE190665/GSE190986 in-vivo partial reprogramming study provide processed mouse count matrices for age-matched OSKM or dox-treated versus control tissue samples. The predeclared senescence and SASP/inflammation marker panels have complete coverage and aggregate treated-minus-control deltas are negative, but only 10 of 18 accession-by-tissue scopes satisfy both directions, so the claim remains needs_data rather than passed.

Cross-method AgeClockShift-up probe: the GSE165180 SuperSeries points to the GSE165179 MPTR lentiviral methylation SubSeries with processed EPIC beta values. Horvath353 scoring over same-donor baseline fibroblast versus day-10 exp2 transiently reprogrammed MPTR fibroblast samples gives a negative mean DNAm-age delta, but the fixed deterministic null is not small enough, so this remains an age_signature-layer needs_data contact and does not promote identity, function, safety, rejuvenation, maintenance, or immortality.
